Amplified Hearing.name: Amplified Hearing
Amplified Hearing.description: Provides +2 bonus to Perception checks that use hearing.

Anti-Dazzle.name: Anti-Dazzle
Anti-Dazzle.description:
Provides immunity to dazzling effects like those produced by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.e8gDMbdK1oPKwhqW]{Flashbang Grenades}.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Artificial Shoulder Mount.name: Artificial Shoulder Mount
Artificial Shoulder Mount.description:
Allows you to install an extra pair of cyberarms.

Additional cyberarms are sold & installed separately.

Install your extra pair of foundational Cyberarms as normal, do not install your extra cyberarms into this item.

Audio Recorder.name: Audio Recorder
Audio Recorder.description: Can save audio recordings onto a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gAfBLrpJzkKVtr8o]{Memory Chip} or linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}.

AudioVox.name: AudioVox
AudioVox.description: Autotune synthesizer. Provides +2 to Acting and Play Instrument checks.

Big Knucks.name: Big Knucks
Big Knucks.description: Armored knuckles which function as a Melee Weapon. Can be concealed without a check.

Biomonitor.name: Biomonitor
Biomonitor.description: Provides an LED showing vitals readouts. Can be linked to your agent.

Braindance Recorder.name: Braindance Recorder
Braindance Recorder.description: Records your memories onto a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gAfBLrpJzkKVtr8o]{Memory Chip} or linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}. Playback requires a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Ed0JaqTO1JyAUa47]{Braindance Viewer}.

Bug Detector.name: Bug Detector
Bug Detector.description: Notifies the user of bugs or taps within 2m/yds.

Chemical Analyzer.name: Chemical Analyzer
Chemical Analyzer.description:
Test the chemical composition of a sample as an action.

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Chemskin.name: Chemskin
Chemskin.description:
Permanent dyes implanted into the skin.

+2 Personal Grooming when installed with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.opzHe5mz24EwqNCM]{Techhair}. Effects do not stack.

Chipware Socket.name: Chipware Socket
Chipware Socket.description: Single socket for installation and removal of a piece of chipware.

Chyron.name: Chyron
Chyron.description: Tiny screen in your eye. Provides picture-in-picture for those boring moments.

Color Shift.name: Color Shift
Color Shift.description: Allows you to shift eyes to an unlimited number of colors and patterns.

Cyberarm.name: Cyberarm
Cyberarm.description: A cybernetic arm with room for upgrades.

Cybersnake.name: Cybersnake
Cybersnake.description: Install a weaponized tentacle into your throat that can be concealed without a check.

Dartgun.name: Dartgun
Dartgun.description: Store and shoot a single dart from your eye.

Difficult Skill Chip.name: Difficult Skill Chip
Difficult Skill Chip.description:
Provides a value of 3 to a specific (x2) skill while installed (provides no effect if the skill is already 3+).

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Requires manual AE creation.

Exposed Covering (Cyber Arm).name: Exposed Covering (Cyber Arm)
Exposed Covering (Cyber Arm).description: Your cybernetics are exposed, maybe you should purchase a covering for your arm?

Exposed Covering (Cyber Leg).name: Exposed Covering (Cyber Leg)
Exposed Covering (Cyber Leg).description: Your cybernetics are exposed, maybe you should purchase a covering for your arm?

Grapple Hand.name: Grapple Hand
Grapple Hand.description:
A 30m retractable grappling hook embedded into your hand.

Cannot be used to Grapple a target at range.

Grip Foot.name: Grip Foot
Grip Foot.description:
Provides traction for climbing vertically.

Must be paired.

Hardened Shielding (Cyber Arm).name: Hardened Shielding (Cyber Arm)
Hardened Shielding (Cyber Arm).description: The arm and installed options are not affected by EMP effects.

Hardened Shielding (Cyber Leg).name: Hardened Shielding (Cyber Leg)
Hardened Shielding (Cyber Leg).description: The leg and installed options are not affected by EMP effects.

Hidden Holster.name: Hidden Holster
Hidden Holster.description:
A holster that is concealed inside you without a check.

Can only conceal a normally concealable weapon.

Homing Tracer.name: Homing Tracer
Homing Tracer.description:
Provides audio tracking of a paired @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.IqXTqNGBmSuigIWv]{Tracer Button} up to 1 mile.

Replacements not included.

Image Enhance.name: Image Enhance
Image Enhance.description:
Provides +2 Perception, Lip Reading, and Conceal/Reveal Object when using sight.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Implanted Linear Frame β (Beta).name: Implanted Linear Frame β (Beta)
Implanted Linear Frame β (Beta).description:
Increases your BODY stat to 14

An Internal Linear Frame can be identified with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.cybertech #DV13 Cybertech]]{DV13 Cybertech} check.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace} x2 (Installed Separately) & BODY 8

Implanted Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma).name: Implanted Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma)
Implanted Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma).description:
Increases your BODY stat to 12

An Internal Linear Frame can be identified with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.cybertech #DV13 Cybertech]]{DV13 Cybertech} check.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace} x1 (Installed Separately) & BODY 6

Interface Plugs.name: Interface Plugs
Interface Plugs.description: Plugs in the wrist or head to allow you to connect to machines/systems hands-free.

Internal Agent.name: Internal Agent
Internal Agent.description: Built in @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{agent}. Audio only but can be linked with other cybergear.

Jump Booster.name: Jump Booster
Jump Booster.description:
Built-in hydraulics negates penalty for jumping.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Level Damper.name: Level Damper
Level Damper.description: Provides immunity to deafness or sudden loud noises like those produced by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.e8gDMbdK1oPKwhqW]{Grenade (Flashbang)}

Light Tattoo.name: Light Tattoo
Light Tattoo.description:
Glowing tattoos. +2 to Wardrobe & Style if you have at least three installed.

Requires manual action to enable/disable the provided Active Effects

Low Light/IR/UV.name: Low Light/IR/UV
Low Light/IR/UV.description:
Ignore any vision penalties due to lighting or fog/smoke.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Meat Arm.name: Meat Arm
Meat Arm.description:
A normal organic arm.

Can support attachments like a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.BUKAOysOkAkwaRqo]{Standard Hand} or other weapons & tools that can be installed into a meat arm.

Meat Foot.name: Meat Foot
Meat Foot.description: Looks like a normal foot for the most part.

Meat Hand.name: Meat Hand
Meat Hand.description: Looks like a normal hand for the most part.

Meat Leg.name: Meat Leg
Meat Leg.description:
A normal organic leg.

Can support attachments like a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.W7S33SRvtrZUpceP]{Standard Foot} or other weapons & tools that can be installed into a meat leg.

Medical Grade Cyberarm.name: Medical Grade Cyberarm
Medical Grade Cyberarm.description: A medical grade cyberarm with no room for upgrades.

Medical Grade Cyberleg.name: Medical Grade Cyberleg
Medical Grade Cyberleg.description: A medical grade cyberleg with no room for upgrades.

Medscanner.name: Medscanner
Medscanner.description: Built-in @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.xW4PlIcWJ82QSfSh]{Medscanner} which allows for quick assessment of injuries. Provides +2 to First Aid and Paramedic skill checks.

Memory Chip.name: Memory Chip
Memory Chip.description:
Data Storage. Like a flash drive for your brain. Eject safely.

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

MicroVideo.name: MicroVideo
MicroVideo.description: Record first person video with a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.clCxd7qkp2olsKii]{camera} installed into your eye. Videos can be saved onto a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gAfBLrpJzkKVtr8o]{Memory Chip} or linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}.

MultiOptic Mount.name: MultiOptic Mount
MultiOptic Mount.description:
Allows you to install up to 5 additional eyes.

Additional @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.aC234RUXPPUb08cO]{Cybereyes} are sold & installed separately. — Do not install your extra cybereyes into this item.

Nasal Filters.name: Nasal Filters
Nasal Filters.description: Provides immunity to inhalable gases or fumes like those produced by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.3rtsVDMaB16lc5tY]{Teargas Grenades}.

Neural Link.name: Neural Link
Neural Link.description: Provides root access to your nervous system.

Olfactory Boost.name: Olfactory Boost
Olfactory Boost.description:
A boosted sense of smell that allows scent tracking.

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Pain Editor.name: Pain Editor
Pain Editor.description:
Removes Seriously Wounded penalties.

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Plastic Covering (Cyber Arm).name: Plastic Covering (Cyber Arm)
Plastic Covering (Cyber Arm).description: A type of plastic coating for your arm.

Plastic Covering (Cyber Leg).name: Plastic Covering (Cyber Leg)
Plastic Covering (Cyber Leg).description: A type of plastic coating for your leg.

Popup Grenade Launcher.name: Popup Grenade Launcher
Popup Grenade Launcher.description:
A concealable one-shot @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.KgqUdz9Fs55747gv]{Grenade Launcher}.

Can't hold anything with this hand while activated.

Incompatible with all upgrades except @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.BC8S1sdK0QGdyHNC]{Smartgun Link}.

Popup Melee Weapon.name: Popup Melee Weapon
Popup Melee Weapon.description:
A concealable One-Handed Melee Weapon.

Can't hold anything with this hand while activated.

Requires manual configuration to match the weapon being installed.

Popup Ranged Weapon.name: Popup Ranged Weapon
Popup Ranged Weapon.description:
A concealable One-Handed Ranged Weapon.

Can't hold anything with this hand while activated.

Requires manual configuration to match the weapon being installed.

Popup Shield.name: Popup Shield
Popup Shield.description:
A foldable shield that can be drawn or concealed easily.

Can't hold anything with this hand while activated.

Add a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_armor.Item.Bg1YEeF25HhfrzOG]{Bullet Proof Shield} to inventory to manage shield HP.

Quick Change Mount.name: Quick Change Mount
Quick Change Mount.description: Your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.RT4NU0EbvmkgoSpZ]{cyberarm} can be detached, re-attached, or swapped using your open socket. Keep an arm for every occasion.

Radar Detector.name: Radar Detector
Radar Detector.description: Notifies the user when it detects a radar signal within a 100m/yd radius.

Radar/Sonar Implant.name: Radar/Sonar Implant
Radar/Sonar Implant.description: Scans the surrounding terrain in a 50m/yd radius around you. Works underwater, but not through cover.

Radiation Detector.name: Radiation Detector
Radiation Detector.description: Shows radiation as a blue glow. Maximum range 100m/yds.

Radio Scanner/Music Player.name: Radio Scanner/Music Player
Radio Scanner/Music Player.description: Tune into CitiNet radio stations or play music saved locally on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gAfBLrpJzkKVtr8o]{Memory Chip}.

Realskinn Covering (Cyber Arm).name: Realskinn Covering (Cyber Arm)
Realskinn Covering (Cyber Arm).description: An artificial skin type for your arm.

Realskinn Covering (Cyber Leg).name: Realskinn Covering (Cyber Leg)
Realskinn Covering (Cyber Leg).description: An artificial skin type for your leg.

Rippers.name: Rippers
Rippers.description:
Medium melee weapons concealed in your fingernails. Can be concealed without a check.

You are unable to hold anything in this hand while activated.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.

Sandevistan.name: Sandevistan
Sandevistan.description:
Speedware that provides +3 to Initiative for 1 min.

Requires a 1hr cooldown between uses.

Scrambler/Descrambler.name: Scrambler/Descrambler
Scrambler/Descrambler.description: Encodes and decodes any transmissions you send or receive.

Scratchers.name: Scratchers
Scratchers.description:
Light melee weapons concealed in your fingernails. Can be concealed without a check.

You are unable to hold anything in this hand while activated.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.

Sensor Array.name: Sensor Array
Sensor Array.description:
Allows you to install up to 5 additional cyberaudio options.

Manually adjust your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.hsoSD662cLKvHKZJ]{Cyberaudio Suite}'s number of slots to 8.

Shift Tacts.name: Shift Tacts
Shift Tacts.description: Change eye color. Can be activated/deactivated at will.

Shoulder Cam.name: Shoulder Cam
Shoulder Cam.description: A concealable camera that pops out of your shoulder. Footage can be stored on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gAfBLrpJzkKVtr8o]{Memory Chip} or linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}.

Skate Foot.name: Skate Foot
Skate Foot.description:
While running your movement is increased by 6m/yds.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Skill Chip.name: Skill Chip
Skill Chip.description:
Provides a value of 3 to a specific skill while installed (provides no effect if the skill is already 3+).

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Requires manual AE creation.

Skin Weave.name: Skin Weave
Skin Weave.description:
Reinforced mesh embedded into your skin that can slowly repair itself.

Add @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_armor.Item.DXavZyl7CTtgoZ6i]{Skin Weave} to track SP

Skinwatch.name: Skinwatch
Skinwatch.description: An LED display that shows the time and date through your skin.

Slice 'N Dice.name: Slice 'N Dice
Slice 'N Dice.description:
Monofilament wiring that can be used as a Medium Melee Weapon. Can be concealed without a check.

You are unable to hold anything in this hand while activated.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.

Subdermal Armor.name: Subdermal Armor
Subdermal Armor.description:
Reinforced mesh embedded beneath your skin that can slowly repair itself.

Add @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_armor.Item.M96Dfx18YqvhlIgb]{Subdermal Armor} to track SP

Subdermal Grip.name: Subdermal Grip
Subdermal Grip.description:
Plating on your hand which allows you to utilize Smartguns.

Requires a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.ju5Rq9rOe2lpDKKl]{Neural Link} to function.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.

Superchrome® Covering (Cyber Arm).name: Superchrome® Covering (Cyber Arm)
Superchrome® Covering (Cyber Arm).description:
A metallic coating for your arm. Provides +2 to Wardrobe and Style.

Effects do not stack

Superchrome® Covering (Cyber Leg).name: Superchrome® Covering (Cyber Leg)
Superchrome® Covering (Cyber Leg).description:
A metallic coating for your leg. Provides +2 to Wardrobe and Style.

Effects do not stack

Tactile Boost.name: Tactile Boost
Tactile Boost.description:
Can detect motion up to 20m/yd away through surface vibrations.

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Talon Foot.name: Talon Foot
Talon Foot.description:
A retractable blade in your foot.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gDN0U6mp3axrm9KQ]{Meat Leg} as the only piece of cyberware.

Targeting Scope.name: Targeting Scope
Targeting Scope.description:
Provides a +1 to aimed shots.

Effects of multiple targeting scopes do not stack.

Techhair.name: Techhair
Techhair.description:
Light-up color-changing artificial hair.

+2 Personal Grooming when installed with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.6jicmuwJKrB98O1R]{Chemskin}. Effects do not stack.

Techscanner.name: Techscanner
Techscanner.description: Contains a variety of built-in gadgets and tools. Provides a +2 bonus to multiple skill checks.

TeleOptics.name: TeleOptics
TeleOptics.description: Telescope in your eye that can see up to 800m/yds and provides a +1 bonus to ranged attacks from greater than 50m/yds away.

Tool Hand.name: Tool Hand
Tool Hand.description:
Each finger in your hand has a different tool. Great for Techs!

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.

Vampyres.name: Vampyres
Vampyres.description: Razor sharp teeth that can conceal and administer a single dose of drugs or poison.

Virtuality.name: Virtuality
Virtuality.description:
Built-in @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.ECoCsPyfIEBCSggM]{virtuality goggles}.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Web Foot.name: Web Foot
Web Foot.description:
Webbing between your toes allows you to swim.

Cyberware must be paired to provide associated benefit.

Wolvers.name: Wolvers
Wolvers.description:
Heavy melee weapons which retract from between your knuckles. Can be concealed without a check.

You are unable to hold anything in this hand while activated.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.
